text:
raj: FYI we're seeing packet loss between pods in gpu-workloads and platform-svc across namespaces — KV syncs failing.
emma: which cluster/region?
raj: us-west-2, cluster-3 (gpu-fleet). tail latency spikes + retries.
oliver: any recent netpols applied?
raj: kubeops rolled a NetPolicy yesterday (PR #842). suspect egress rules.
raj: tcpdump from pod shows ICMP frag needed and then drops. short dump: 
raj: ```
14:02:11.123 IP 10.4.12.5 > 10.4.34.7: ICMP frag needed, mtu 1400
14:02:11.124 IP 10.4.12.5 > 10.4.34.7: UDP, length 1500
```
emma: host MTU on nodes?
infra-bot: host-mtu-check: node-3=1500 node-4=1500 overlay=1400
maria: overlay MTU 1400 + app sending 1500 UDP = fragmentation. netpol can interfere with fragments/ephemeral replies and conntrack.
raj: `kubectl describe netpolicy -n gpu-workloads allow-kv-sync` shows:
raj: ```
Name: allow-kv-sync
Egress:
  To:
    - podSelector: matchLabels: app: platform-svc
  Ports:
    - protocol: UDP port: 9000
```
oliver: platform-svc uses UDP 9000 and 9001 and also returns on ephemeral ports. NetPolicy only allowed 9000 outbound — replies on ephemeral ports get dropped.
emma: that explains asymmetric flows + packet loss.
raj: iperf UDP baseline test: 
raj: ```
[  3]  0.0-10.0 sec  120 MBytes  100 Mbits/sec  24% loss
```
sre-oncall: quick mitigation — add egress rule allowing ephemeral ports (1024-65535) to podSelector platform-svc or allow established responses.
maria: proposed fix in kubeops PR: add UDP ports 9000-9001 plus egress portRange 1024-65535 for that podSelector.
raj: example patch snippet: 
raj: ```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-kv-sync
  namespace: gpu-workloads
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      role: kv-client
  policyTypes:
    - Egress
  egress:
    - to:
      - podSelector:
          matchLabels:
            app: platform-svc
      ports:
        - protocol: UDP
          port: 9000
        - protocol: UDP
          port: 9001
        - protocol: UDP
          port: 1024-65535
```
emma: rolling the patch to reapply allow-egress-all for gpu-workloads for 15m as temporary safety.
oliver: applied the emergency rollback patch, monitoring dashboards.
raj: latency normalized, packet loss dropped to <1% after patch.
maria: follow-up: add a CI test that validates netpols for UDP services with MTU-sized packets + ephemeral response ports; add a short checklist for kubeops PR reviewers.
raj: I'll file infra-issue and link the kubeops PR.
oliver: :thumbsup:
